query:
WITH latest_populations AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.district,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) as population_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
  WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE 
    AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
    AND TRIM(hl.city) = 'الرياض'
    AND hl.district IS NOT NULL
    AND hl.district NOT IN ('خارج حدود الاحياء', 'بدون اسم')
    AND hl.category = 'احياء معتمدة'
  GROUP BY hl.district
),
previous_populations AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.district,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) as population_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
  WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE 
    AND hp.snapshot = (
      SELECT MAX(snapshot) 
      FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala 
      WHERE snapshot < (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
    )
    AND TRIM(hl.city) = 'الرياض'
    AND hl.district IS NOT NULL
    AND hl.district NOT IN ('خارج حدود الاحياء', 'بدون اسم')
    AND hl.category = 'احياء معتمدة'
  GROUP BY hl.district
)
SELECT 
  lp.district,
  (lp.population_count - COALESCE(pp.population_count, 0)) as population_increase
FROM latest_populations lp
LEFT JOIN previous_populations pp ON lp.district = pp.district
WHERE lp.population_count > 0
ORDER BY population_increase DESC
LIMIT 10
